en.headline: About 600 visited Po Pin Chau section on Saturday
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said numbers were lower than expected after morning rain warnings, and bookings through Tuesday are full.
body: About 600 people visited the Po Pin Chau section of Sai Kung East Country Park on Saturday, fewer than the department had expected after poor weather, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said.

The department said it had suspended entry during Saturday morning while the amber rainstorm warning and the thunderstorm warning were in force. It said the viewing point and trails were orderly in the afternoon, with visitors moving through smoothly. Joint patrols with the Marine Department and the police continued around Sharp Island, where about 1,010 people visited on Saturday.

Bookings for the Po Pin Chau section from Sunday 4 October through Tuesday 6 October are already full, the department said, while slots remained for Wednesday 7 October. On Saturday night, Ham Tin Wan, Long Ke Wan and Sai Wan camps together had about 530 tents, and the department described order and hygiene there as good.

Staff also patrolled popular snorkelling spots with the World Wide Fund for Nature Hong Kong, reminding visitors not to step on coral or to feed or collect marine life. The department said officers would enforce rules against littering.

zh.headline: 周六約600人到破邊洲段 日至二預約已滿
zh.dek: 漁護署表示，受早上市況影響，到訪人數較預期低，黃金周10月4日至6日預約已額滿。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，周六約有600人到訪西貢東郊野公園破邊洲段，因天氣欠佳，全日人數較預期低。
署方說，周六早上黃色暴雨警告及雷暴警告生效期間，已暫停遊人進入。下午破邊洲觀景台及山徑秩序良好，人流暢順。署方同海事處及警方在橋咀洲一帶聯合巡邏，周六約有1010人到訪橋咀洲。
署方指出，破邊洲段10月4日至6日的預約已全日額滿，10月7日仍有名額。周六入夜後，鹹田灣、浪茄灣及西灣三個營地合共約530個帳篷，秩序及衞生情況良好。
人員亦聯同世界自然基金會香港分會，在橋咀洲熱門浮潛位置巡查，提醒遊人不要踩踏珊瑚，亦不應餵飼或採集海洋生物。署方表示，一旦發現亂拋垃圾等違規行為，會執法處理。
